name: Murder Build
subtitle: Maximum DPS Output
core_buildings: Attack Speed Tower x3, Damage Amplifier x2, Critical Strike Tower

timeline.early: Start with Wind Ball. Rush to level 5 for Ghost Ball unlock.
timeline.mid: Combine Wind + Ghost for speed boost. Add 2 Attack Speed Towers.
timeline.late: Fuse Elemental combo. Max out Critical Strike Tower. Add Deadeye's Cross passive.

recommended_characters: The Warrior, The Shade, The Empty Nester
strengths: Highest sustained DPS, Excellent for speedruns, Melts bosses in seconds
weaknesses: Low survivability, Requires precise positioning, Vulnerable to bullet hell
strategy: Fuse Elemental combo. Max out Critical Strike Tower. Add Deadeye's Cross passive.

name: Control Build
subtitle: Area Denial Specialist
core_passives: Wings of the Anointed, Ethereal Cloak
core_buildings: Slow Towers x3, Area Expander x2, Wall Fortifications

timeline.early: Build defensive. Get 1-2 Slow Towers by level 10.
timeline.mid: Unlock Magma for area control. Add Wings of the Anointed passive.
timeline.late: Fuse Black Hole evolution. Max Area Expanders. Add Phantom Cloak.

recommended_characters: The Repentant, The Cogitator, The Warrior
strengths: Safest build for beginners, Dominates The Abyss biome, Never takes damage
weaknesses: Slower clear times, Boss fights take 30+ minutes, Less exciting gameplay
strategy: Fuse Black Hole evolution. Max Area Expanders. Add Phantom Cloak.

name: Empty Nester
subtitle: Nuclear Screen Clear
core_buildings: Cooldown Reduction x3, Area Expander x2, Critical Strike Tower

timeline.early: Survive to level 20. Minimal building investment.
timeline.mid: Rush Nuclear Bomb evolution path. Add Cooldown towers.
timeline.late: Trigger Empty Nester combo. Time nuclear explosions perfectly.

recommended_characters: The Empty Nester, The Shade, The Itchy Finger
strengths: One-shot entire screens, Fastest speedrun potential, Most satisfying combos
weaknesses: Extremely high skill cap, Inconsistent damage, Punishing if you miss timing
pros: Can clear The Core in 25 minutes
strategy: Trigger Empty Nester combo. Time nuclear explosions perfectly.

name: Vampire Sustain
subtitle: Immortal Tank
core_buildings: HP Regeneration x3, Damage Amplifier x2, Shield Generator

timeline.early: Build HP regeneration immediately. Survive to level 15.
timeline.mid: Unlock Soul Reaver passive. Start Vampire evolution path.
timeline.late: Complete Nosferatu fusion. Add Crimson Covenant. Become unkillable.

recommended_characters: The Spendthrift, The Warrior, The Flagellant
strengths: Literally cannot die, Beginner-friendly, Consistent 40+ minute runs
weaknesses: Slowest DPS, Boss fights take forever, Boring for some players
strategy: Complete Nosferatu fusion. Add Crimson Covenant. Become unkillable.

name: Satan Rush
subtitle: Ultimate Evolution Speedrun
core_passives: Deadeye's Cross, Wings of the Anointed
core_buildings: XP Boost Towers x3, Attack Speed Tower x2, Area Expander

timeline.early: Rush levels with Mystic Aura. Get to level 10 in 5 minutes.
timeline.mid: Evolve Charm → Incubus. Simultaneously work on Succubus path.
timeline.late: Fuse Satan at 15-20 minute mark. One-shot everything.

recommended_characters: The Carouser, The Warrior, The Shade
strengths: Fastest Satan evolution, Dominates after completion, Excellent for challenges
weaknesses: Weak before Satan, Complex evolution path, Requires precise timing
strategy: Fuse Satan at 15-20 minute mark. One-shot everything.
